description: Election Commission - Mr. W. A. S. Wijesingha of the Wellawaya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Wellawaya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office, which is an electoral matter related to local government. The notice is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifically references Section 10 A (1) (a), making it clearly about electoral processes and declarations, fitting Type 7 (Elections).
